messages.text:
"Make me a 2D pixel art story mode game with a big open world I can explore freely. The world has different areas like a village, forest, desert, caves and dungeons. There is a main story with chapters and quests, plus side quests from NPCs I can talk to. I can fight enemies and bosses, collect items and coins, level up, and get stronger weapons and armor. Add secrets and hidden places to discover, a save system so I can continue later, and simple touch controls for mobile. The player makes their own choices in the story, and the choices change what happens next. There are 8 endings in total: 5 bad endings, 2 good endings, and 1 secret ending that is hard to find
"
